fact: The Global Fund's Office of the Inspector General, in its audit report of 16 December 2024, states that the national health management information system (DHIS2) has been rolled out at all health facilities in Uganda, removing the need for manual reporting; it gives no numerator, denominator or breakdown by facility level.
title: Audit Report: Global Fund Grants in the Republic of Uganda (GF-OIG-24-020)
publisher: The Global Fund, Office of the Inspector General
